high_level_description: The image depicts a square ceramic tile with a vibrant and colorful floral design. The background of the tile is a bright blue color, which serves as a striking contrast to the flowers and leaves painted on it. The flowers are stylized and appear to be sunflowers, characterized by their large yellow petals with pink edges and dark centers that resemble sunflower seeds. There are also smaller, more delicate flowers interspersed among the larger ones, including a purple flower at the top center. The leaves are green with white outlines, adding to the intricate detailing of the design.
